HRA Analysis: The season at Burnie kicks off with a small maiden field, where Tammy Langley trains three of the six runners. VOODOO RANGER (5) continues to threaten to break his duck and again looks a strong chance here, even from the outside front-row draw. BLISSFULL RED (1) was held up until late first up in the state and gets the pole draw around the small Burnie circuit, so should get her chance for an all-the-way victory if she is able to push through and hold the front. ARRIVAL TIME (2) has run some handy races this campaign in the state and looks one of the clear dangers. CHASING THE ACE (6) and HIGH FROSTY (4) have shown some ability at the trials and look capable of improving with further racing, while SPORTY GRANT (3) will need to improve on recent performances to be winning here. Selections:BLISSFULL RED (1), VOODOO RANGER (5), ARRIVAL TIME (2), CHASING THE ACE (6)

Expecting some good speed early here, with all the horses off the front row known to possess gate speed when asked. This should allow a horse like KENYA (7) to put the foot down with a touch over a lap to go and try to outstay them, or potentially even earlier, as he regularly does in his races. QUEENOFDANCE (6) is another who should thrive off an early tempo and be finishing home strongly if she sees any open space. NATIONAL NEWS (8) could be the one at odds after dropping slightly in grade here. KNOCK OUT (4) is threatening to win a race but may have to be driven more quietly here with the known gate speed drawn to her inside. Selections:KENYA (7), QUEENOFDANCE (6), NATIONAL NEWS (8), KNOCK OUT (4)

A stand-start event over the short distance, where the sharp beginners in SAPPHIRE GAMBLE (3) and FLEETWOOD ROCK (4) will be looking to ping away and find the front, which would give both their chance to return to form. ITSMENOTU (1) returns from a let-up and, at her best, should be right in the finish with the chance to receive a soft run from the pole draw. TULLAH GIRL (5) enjoyed a nice run in transit when getting the money last start and will again be looking to find a spot on speed with cover, which should give her every chance to be running home strongly. Selections:SAPPHIRE GAMBLER (3), ITSMENOTU (1), FLEETWOOD ROCK (4), TULLAH GIRL (5)

REPETITIVE (2) is normally a reliable beginner from the stand and will look to jump in front here and attempt an all-the-way victory. It has been a while between drinks, but he won't get a better chance than what he appears to have here. EYE SEE AMOUR (3) has plenty of ability when he puts it all together and, if he steps safely at his second attempt from the stand, will take some holding out late. CHAMONIX (1) gets his chance to improve on his recent form from the pole, while ALBERIO (7) is a stand-start specialist and, even from the 10-metre handicap, should look to find a spot handy to the speed and could be the one at odds. Selections:REPETITIVE (2), EYE SEE AMOUR (3), CHAMONIX (1), ALBERIO (7)

RANIERI (3) looks to be the best beginner off the front row here and should appreciate getting back to Burnie, where he has a good record overall. CINCINNATI (1) and LA PIERRE (2) will be looking to take advantage of their good front-row draws and find spots on speed, which makes them the main dangers. COLORADO GIRL (5) and NO NUKES SKIPPER (9) look the best of the 10-metre markers and should be finishing off strongly if there is any genuine tempo throughout. Selections:RANIERI (3), CINCINNATI (1), LA PIERRE (2), COLORADO GIRL (5)

The last stand-start event of the night, where MIKI SANZ (4) will look to find a position on speed and run his usual honest race. OLLIES MEDAL (1) could either fly away or miss it badly from the pole draw, but if he begins safely, he could be hard to run down around the tight circuit. LIKEABLE ROGUE (2) could be the one at odds if he finds a nice spot on speed after not having much luck at his past few starts. ROCKS ROY (7) and CAN FEEL THE FURY (8) can never be left out in these sorts of races but will be relying on a good tempo to allow them to run home strongly, as will GOBSMACKED (6). SETTEBELLO (5) could also run a race at odds if he pings away as he usually does. Selections:MIKI SANZ (4), LIKEABLE ROGUE (2), OLLIES MEDAL (1), SETTEBELLO (5)

The mobile event for the No More Than Three Win horses, where ULTIMATE GLADIATOR (6) and SOHO TIGERLILY (10) clearly bring the best form into the race but draw awkwardly from wide and back-row gates. However, there does look to be some good tempo early from the front row, with TASSIE DAZZLER (3) and GEMMY LOU (5) involved. OSCAR MAC (1) makes his debut in the state and is first up for 16 months. He gets the pole draw but hasn't shown much gate speed in the past, so it will be interesting to see where he settles in the run. KING BART (4) and STANTON BREAK (8) are consistent placegetters in this grade and could be right in the finish with a nice run in transit. Selections:ULTIMATE GLADIATOR (6), SOHO TIGER LILY (10), KING BART (4), GEMMY LOU (5)

OUTBACK LASS (1) was narrowly defeated when leading last start and looks to get her chance to return to the winner's circle here. Expect her to hold up from the pole draw despite the speedy AWAY GAME (5) being drawn towards the outside of the front row, and she could be hard to run down. DANCINWIVJOLENE (3) should get a nice sit on speed and, at her best, looks the main danger, along with ALBY PRIDDY (4), who will be looking to slot in early. LALIBELA (9) and ONEOFTHELADS (10) will be relying on some genuine tempo throughout to allow them to run home strongly. Selections:OUTBACK LASS (1), DANCINWIVJOLENE (3), AWAY GAME (5), ALBY PRIDDY (4) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW: This is a very even race with plenty of chances to open the meeting. ELIZAJANE (9) is in brilliant form, having won three of her last five starts. All of her recent wins have come when she has found the front. She will have a different race map here, but it should still suit her. She has the best sectional times in this event. BREATHE EASY (1) has great gate speed and is racing well. He has the option to hold the front or take a sit, but he is suited over the short trip. INTERPRETATION (7) is racing well despite her only fair numerical form. She has faced some tough race maps recently and comes up against another tricky barrier here, but with some luck, she is a winning chance. MISTER JIMARINGLE (5) was restricted for racing room late last start but looked to be letting down nicely. He is racing well and, if he can map favourably here, he is a great chance. Also respecting YANKEE MOJOH (11), who is flying at the moment. However, barrier 11 over the short trip at Kilmore will be difficult to overcome. SELECTIONS: ELIZAJANE (9), BREATHE EASY (1), INTERPRETATION (7), MISTER JIMARINGLE (5)

OVERVIEW:KIMCHI (9) drops in class here, having not contested an NR up to 40 race in quite some time. He has been racing well, has a good relationship with driver Taylor Youl and should be able to follow through at the start. THE LADYBIRD (5) was an eye-catching winner at Horsham last start. She found a good position midfield, was saved for one run and flew home to win nicely. If she can find a similar race map here, she can go back-to-back. MIKI MARK (7) is racing consistently well and has rarely finished outside the top five recently. He faces a tricky barrier here. TOMMYS LOOKOUT (6) is an interesting runner. At his last two starts, he has worked hard to find the front and tired a little late. He has the best last sectional times in this field. If he can slot into a good position without being used too hard early, he will be a threat late. Also respecting LAVADA GOLD (2) here. SELECTIONS: KIMCHI (9), THE LADYBIRD (5), MIKI MARK (7), TOMMYS LOOKOUT (6),

OVERVIEW:THREE SIX THREE (2) is a very well-bred colt making his debut. He is by Captaintreacherous out of Art De Triomphe, making him a brother to Gawn and Petillante. He used the sprint lane to win a trial at this track in late September, although it was in slow time. We will learn more about his ability here, and whatever he does, he will likely improve from the experience. AMANDO (3) is having his second career start. On debut, he tired and dropped out before being sent back to the trials. Although the trial was run in slow time, the way he won looked impressive. I am happy to give him another chance here. ELLIANA (11) came close to breaking through for her maiden victory on several occasions last preparation. She is first-up here and will be vulnerable from the tricky barrier, but she is one of the better horses in this field on exposed form. HEAVENLY NIKKY (9) is another horse who has come close to breaking through for her maiden victory on several occasions. She is racing well and now comes up against a tricky barrier, so she will need some luck to find clear running late. However, she is a winning chance here. SELECTIONS: THREE SIX THREE (2), AMANDO (3), ELLIANA (11), HEAVENLY NIKKY (9)

OVERVIEW:CRACKIN PHILTRA (4) has had only three career starts since November 18, but they have all been good runs. He returned to the track in October, racing in the breeze and fighting on strongly. He will improve with fitness and appears to be a classy type. LIBERTY STAR DUST (7) has the best sectional times on exposed form in this field. He finished second last start behind Cyclone Jenni at Cranbourne after flashing home. With the right run, he will be flashing home again. TRYX VIXEN (3) is a smart filly who is racing well and suits barrier three. ULTIMATE GRANGE (6) is having his fourth career start here. Forget his last run, as he had a flat tyre. His previous start was a nice win at Ballarat. I also have plenty of respect for JANSEN (5), who rarely runs a poor race. TOSWEETTOTAME (2) is a first starter here, but his trial form has included some well-beaten efforts. BACK: CRACKIN PHILTRA (4)– 4 units (win) SELECTIONS: CRACKIN PHILTRA (4), LIBERTY STAR DUST (7), TRYX VIXEN (3), ULTIMATE GRANGE (6)

OVERVIEW:MELICAN (6) is an exciting young filly for Rebecca Barley. She has had two career starts for two wins, with a cumulative winning margin of 44.9 metres. We are yet to discover her ceiling. FOREGONE CONCLUSION (1) is an experienced performer stepping out for his 205th start. He is racing well and should get a good run along the fence here. ALTIUS (2) is in great form after winning nicely first-up last start. With his great gate speed, he is likely to find the fence here. CATIES SON (8) is first-up but is the only horse on the back row. He has options from there. I also respect THE BLAZINBOOTS (7), who is in great form but faces a poor barrier. BACK: MELICAN (6)– 4 units (win) SELECTIONS: MELICAN (6), FOREGONE CONCLUSION (1), ALTIUS (2), CATIES SON (8)

OVERVIEW:TOBYS SHOUT (7) was ultra-impressive last start at Wagga. He was wide early, worked forward to the breeze and was simply too good late. He has the best sectional times in this event. The barrier is a concern, but he can make his own luck. ROCK POSTER (5) is third-up here and should be approaching peak fitness. She was too far back to get into the race last start, while at her previous outing she ran home nicely for third at Ballarat. She should improve with fitness but will need some luck from the barrier. THEROUX (3) found his best form last start to win at Ballarat. He was three-back on the fence, got wide late and ran home well. He has his winning confidence back. MISS PIGGY WIGGY (6) led and won nicely last start at Shepparton. She is unlikely to find the front here, but she is racing well. Keep an eye on HIGHVIEW HAMMER (4) early. He has good gate speed and, if he can map well, he also comes into contention. SELECTIONS: ROCK POSTER (5), THEROUX (3), TOBYS SHOUT (7), MISS PIGGY WIGGY (6)

OVERVIEW:TALKNPLAY (4) was first-up last start since December 2025 and was also making his debut for new trainer Mark Thompson. He led and was too good late. Expect an improved performance here with added fitness. KNOW THE SCORE (3) can be forgiven for his last start, when he galloped due to a gear malfunction. Prior to that, he had been racing quite well. He has a nice turn of foot. REASON TO LAUGH (5) has won two of his last three starts and is in career-best form. He is a good swooper and, if saved for one run, will be flashing home. SHEZABLUECHIP (6) raced in the breeze to win well last start at Shepparton. She faces a tricky barrier here but can make her own luck. SELECTIONS: TALKNPLAY (4), KNOW THE SCORE (3), REASON TO LAUGH (5), SHEZABLUECHIP (6)

OVERVIEW: This is a nice race, with every horse in the field appearing to be a progressive type with an exciting future. DECODE (6) is a nice horse for Chris Svanosio. He finished eighth last start in a Victoria Derby heat, running home nicely despite it being his first look at the 2760-metre trip. He is a very talented horse and ran a brilliant 1:50.7 at Wagga the start prior. Back to the shorter trip here, he will be hard to beat. DELIGHTFUL MIKI (5) ran home nicely to finish a respectable third at Melton last start. She is a smart mare. Abby Sanderson has two runners in this event, CAPTAIN MOLLY (1) and THE WISE GUY (7), and both have plenty of ability and look to be progressive types. However, both are first-up and may need the run. CAPTAIN MOLLY (1) is suited by barrier one and should get a good trip. THE WISE GUY (7) has not raced since August 2025, so he may be vulnerable from the barrier. STORM VENDETTA (2) won in nice time last start at Ballarat. He has a great turn of foot, but this is a tough race. BACK: DECODE (6)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: DECODE (6), DELIGHTFUL MIKI (5), CAPTAIN MOLLY (1), STORM VENDETTA (2) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW: The opening event at Melton is a maiden, but there are plenty of smart horses early in their careers, making this a competitive race. MYDEEPESTDESIRE (4) has had three career starts, drawing poor barriers each time and enduring three very tough runs in narrow defeat. He clearly has ability, is tough and shouldn’t remain a maiden for long. PET WOLF (3) is another impressive, lightly raced horse. He has had four starts since December 2025 and has yet to miss a place. He has good gate speed and is likely to find the fence first here. EVA EXPRESS (2) is having her second career start. On debut, she finished fourth after flashing home nicely when popping out from a three-back-the-fence position. She should improve with the experience and added fitness. MYSTIC MOTIVER (9) covered an extra 41 metres while racing wide last start and was still rattling home late to finish second. She looks like a smart type and has been unlucky not to break through for her maiden victory. BACK: MYDEEPESTDESIRE (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: MYDEEPESTDESIRE (4), PET WOLF (3), EVA EXPRESS (2), MYSTIC MOTIVER (9)

OVERVIEW:FREAK OUT (9) is a consistent, experienced horse who rarely puts in a bad run. He can make his own luck, although he sometimes seems to lack the high speed needed late when surrounded by swoopers. He is a nice horse with a good barrier here, allowing him to follow through early and find a handy position. FAKE CULLECTION (5) is fourth-up here and should be approaching peak fitness. She got too far back last start to win, but she let down nicely and looked determined. If she can map well, she will be a threat late. BETTOR DOO (8) is a former Mildura horse who recently moved to Bendigo trainer Brent Curran. He has had two starts since the change of scenery, finishing fourth before scoring a last-start win at Shepparton, where he did it tough but was simply too good. This is his first look at Melton. He will need luck from the barrier, but he is a smart horse. BETA THAN LOVE (1) has been racing well and has the gate speed and the ideal barrier to get every chance here. SELECTIONS: FREAK OUT (9), FAKE CULLECTION (5), BETTOR DOO (8), BETA THAN LOVE (1)

OVERVIEW:CATCH THE CAPTAIN (1) is an exciting first starter. He is closely related to Catch A Wave and Yambukian and is trained by Andy Gath, who knows the family well. He won a recent Melton trial, running home in 27.5 seconds, although the first two quarters were slow. We will learn more about him here, but he has plenty in his favour. ASHANTE WARRIOR (7) was first-up for Alex Ashwood last start. He worked forward, found the lead and broke through for his maiden victory. This is a step up in class, and he has a tough barrier to overcome. YANKEE GAMBLER (5) is a tough horse who can, and often does, make his own luck. However, he is first-up since February, which could leave him vulnerable here. STAY FOOLISH (3) is a former New South Wales horse having his first start here for Paul Tonkin, who does a great job with his team. Expect improvement with the change of scenery. BACK: CATCH THE CAPTAIN (1) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: CATCH THE CAPTAIN (1), ASHANTE WARRIOR (7), YANKEE GAMBLER (5), STAY FOOLISH (3)

OVERVIEW:BELLA LOUISE (7) has been really good at her past two starts. Two starts ago, she led and won at Ballarat, while last start she was even more impressive despite finishing second. She flashed home from last and was narrowly beaten at Kilmore. Barrier seven is not ideal, but she is racing well. EL LAZZAR (3) recently gave Lochie Cook his first winner as a trainer when he let down nicely at Cranbourne two starts ago. Last start, he flashed home again but was simply too far back. If he is close enough here, his great turn of foot makes him a threat. MUSELET (5) is racing well enough and, if he can map favourably, he should be in the finish. FIVE CENT (2) was impressive last start at Maryborough, doing all the work in the breeze and fighting on well for third. Barrier is suitable, noting GIDGETT KAY (1) is EOD so FIVE CENT (2) comes out of barrier one. SELECTIONS: BELLA LOUISE (7), EL LAZZAR (3), MUSELET (5), FIVE CENT (2)

OVERVIEW: What a terrific field this is for the Scotch Notch 3YO Trotting Colts and Geldings event. NSW Trotters Derby winner PASTOR DUNBAR (6) returns and is one of the most exciting young trotters in the country. He is fast, tough and versatile. Fitness could be the query first-up. Recent Group 1 Vicbred Super Series winner HOWDY MATE (8) will have to navigate an awkward barrier, but if he gets clear running late, he will be flashing home. KYVALLEY RAY (7) is a multiple Group 1 winner who has claimed feature events in Australia and New Zealand. He was dominant in his last-start victory in the Group 1 Need For Speed Final. My only concern is his ability to trot safely throughout. Driver John Caldow suggested in his post-race interview after that win that, although Kyvalley Ray was outstanding, he did not feel the horse was safely in a trot. He is not my top selection here because he comes with that risk. THE PREACHER (5) is a very talented, high-speed horse. He was caught wide last start and did not appear to be at his best. However, if he gets a good run here, he will be flying home late. BACK: PASTOR DUNBAR (6) – 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS: PASTOR DUNBAR (6), HOWDY MATE (8), KYVALLEY RAY (7), THE PREACHER (5)

OVERVIEW: This is a great edition of the Aldebaran Park Graeme Lang Memorial for the two-year-old trotting fillies. KYVALLEY DIXON (7) won the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series Final three starts ago and has been good in defeat at her past two starts. She will need to make her own luck from the barrier, but she has the class to be competitive. ZIPPIN PAST (6) is a high-speed trotter with great gate speed. She has the option to head forward early, but if she is saved for one run, she could be flashing home late. Andy Gath has two talented young trotters engaged in SNOWIN (5) and MAJARO GIRL (9). SNOWIN (5) is a very well-bred daughter of Bold Eagle who raced away to break through for her maiden victory at Ballarat last start, at just her third start. She is improving with every run. MAJARO GIRL (9) is an exciting young trotter who recently won a Vicbred Super Series heat. She has brilliant speed but can get it wrong with her manners. She has had a long campaign but is still racing well and is a major winning chance here. It is worth noting that main stable driver Kate Gath has opted to drive MAJARO GIRL (9) over stablemate SNOWIN (5). SELECTIONS: KYVALLEY DIXON (7), ZIPPIN PAST (6), SNOWIN (5), MAJARO GIRL (9)

OVERVIEW:BUNGY (3) is an interesting horse. I black-booked him as an exciting horse to follow after his first few starts. At times, he has failed to live up to that early promise, but the ability is there. Last start at Kilmore, he was held up late but absolutely flew home to finish third. TOMBEUR (2) has had one career start, producing a tough win at Cranbourne early this month. He had to do the work but was still too good. He should improve with the experience gained from that run. MY MARIONETTE (6) has nice ability when at her best. Her maiden victory last year was eye-catching, particularly the way she let down. She has continued to perform well since without winning and will need luck from the barrier. James Herbertson picks up the drive, but he knows her well, having steered her to victory in her maiden win. TRICODE (7) has the best sectional times in this field, but it will be tough for him from the barrier. SELECTIONS: BUNGY (3), TOMBEUR (2), MY MARIONETTE (6), TRICODE (7)

OVERVIEW: Another terrific field has been assembled for the Aldebaran Park Gavin Lang Memorial for the two-year-old trotting colts and geldings. REGAL GALA (5) was the last-start winner of the Mick Clover Redwood Prelude. He has brilliant gate speed, perfect manners and plenty of toughness. He looks likely to find the front here and will be hard to beat. PHOENIX REX (6) produced one of the best wins I have seen from a young trotter in my career when taking out the Group 2 QBRED 2YO Trotting Final at Albion Park on August 22. He was inconvenienced early, with driver Ryan Sanderson nearly being tipped out, but he recovered, caught the field and proved too good late. His runs since have been a little unlucky, although he has still been slightly below his best. If he brings his best, he is one of the top young trotters in the country. INSULATOR (4) is a smart young trotter who looks to have an exciting future. He recently won a Vicbred Super Series heat, defeating several horses engaged here. He is good enough to be a winning chance but may need some luck. ORLANDO VEYRON (3) was eye-catching when storming home to finish third in the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series Final two starts ago behind Verbici and Regal Gala. Last start, he travelled to Sydney for a feature race but made a mistake with his manners. He is a very fast trotter if he gets the right run. I also would not be surprised to see an improved performance from LUXALICIOUS (2), who was good on debut last start when finishing third at Menangle behind Verbici. BACK: REGAL GALA (5) – 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS: REGAL GALA (5), PHOENIX REX (6), INSULATOR (4), ORLANDO VEYRON (3)

OVERVIEW: This is an interesting maiden with mixed form and several first starters. GATSBY (2) has the best sectional times in this event. Last start, he let down nicely in a race won by Casterton, who looks to be a smart prospect. He has gate speed, and barrier two is ideal, although there are question marks over how quickly the horse inside him, VALLA CHEVAL (1), will begin. DIAMOND AURORA (5) is a well-bred colt from a Christian Cullen mare and by Bettors Delight, a promising pedigree cross. He has won his past two trials, including a victory at this track, and looks well placed. His stablemate SIR KITT (6) also looks well placed in this event. He has had two career starts and showed improvement to win last start behind Hoso Magic after flashing home late. Expect further improvement here. MY ROCKING HORSE (3) is an interesting filly whose ability is difficult to assess against this field. She has recently been racing in top-age-group races against superstar fillies such as Kahula, but has often been at the back of the field. Her performances outside those top-age-group races have been very good, and she should appreciate the company here. SELECTIONS: GATSBY (2), DIAMOND AURORA (5), SIR KITT (6), MY ROCKING HORSE (3) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:SECRET SERVICE AGENT (4) will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment and will take beating. He had little luck from a wide draw when unplaced in the Super Series Final then raced on the outside of the leader throughout over the testing distance of 2760m in a heat of the Victoria Derby last outing. POPCORNFRIDAY (1) was held up for a run at a vital stage, angled wide at the 150m and finished strongly for seventh (2.5m) at Melton last outing. He is a short course specialist and should be reaching his peak after having two starts back from a break so he rates as a value hope. BRINGSUSJOY (3) was held up behind the tiring leader and didn’t have the best of luck when seventh at Metropolitan level last outing. She finished fast to win over Just As Well prior so she warrants respect. DONMARO (10) hasn’t produced his best form since coming from New Zealand but he should be fitter after his first up run and his form across the Tasman was good enough to be competitive here. BACK: SECRET SERVICE AGENT (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SECRET SERVICE AGENT (4), POPCORNFRIDAY (1), BRINGSUSJOY (3), DONMARO (10)

OVERVIEW:TED BEAR (10) finished off strongly from the second half of the field when second behind Our Pinup Girl at Ballarat and followed with a seventh from a similar bad draw at Maryborough. He is likely to settle a long way back again from his similar draw here but he does strike a suitable line up. SPUN SILVER (6) continues to race in good form and should give a forward showing. She led throughout at a Kilmore victory three starts ago and attempted to lead throughout when third in a handy mile of 1.55.0 at Geelong. FLIGHT LOUTENANT (9) struck trouble at his debut for trainer Jess Tubbs after a third at Wagga. He has the perfect trailing draw and is worth another chance. HURRICANE HOOLY (3) is racing consistently and is perfectly drawn to suit her racing pattern. She was forced out very wide from the 400m and had excuses at her latest fourth. SELECTIONS: TED BEAR (10), SPUN SILVER (6), FLIGHT LOUTENANT (9), HURRICANE HOOLY (3)

OVERVIEW: BANIA (11) was heavily supported on debut but lost his chance after breaking stride at the start. He made up many lengths and did a good job to finish as close as he did so he is worth another chance. BAD GRANDMA (8) is awkwardly drawn but was impressive at a recent Melton trial victory in a mile rate of 1.58.0 so she must be respected. THE PRIVATE DEAL (5) is a former New South Wales pacer, which joins trainer Julie Douglas. She finished off quickly to win a Shepparton trial last week and she can improve on her numerical form. MILEY KAY (2) attempted to lead throughout and was run down on the line when a close second behind Cazadero at Swan Hill. This race is no harder and she is worth thought again. SEW HOPEFULL (3) led out then took cover and battled on fairly well for second behind Keayang Maricruz at Kilmore last outing. She is a maiden from 20 starts but she is a definite place chance again. SELECTIONS: BANIA (11), BAD GRANDMA (8), THE PRIVATE DEAL (5), MILEY KAY (2)

OVERVIEW: KOSIMO (8) appears to be very well placed against this line up with his claiming price of $8,000. He possesses a powerful finishing burst and his recent efforts have been in races boasting National Ratings of over 20 points higher than this event. MISTER AMERICANO (5) was resuming from a spell when fifth at Cranbourne, where he was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off fairly well. He performed nicely at the trials prior and should go well against this opposition. LE GASTON (4) led throughout and scored over Storm Vendetta (won since) at Cranbourne on September 13. He has drawn poorly in two starts since and is capable of returning to winning form here. LENARD ESS (6) was suited by a genuine tempo in the early stages and ran over the top of his rivals to win in a mile of 1.55.5 at Geelong last outing. He has won three of his past five starts and should be finishing off nicely again. BACK: KOSIMO (8) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: KOSIMO (8), MISTER AMERICANO (5), LE GASTON (4), LENARD ESS (6)

OVERVIEW:TWIGSTAR (4) is a very promising filly that remains undefeated in two attempts and is the horse to beat again. She worked forward to find the lead and completely dominated her rivals at her latest Cranbourne success in a mile rate of 1.57.0. ARZALI ROCKSTAR (3) produced a big performance to score after racing on the outside of the leader throughout at Geelong last week. She is likely to be driven in a forward manner again and must be considered as one of the leading chances. BRAVE ART (2) copped plenty of pressure in the leading role and did a good job to hold down second in the race won by Lenard Ess last outing. She should give another bold showing from her good draw. OZZIE DIAMOND (1) failed to run on as expected last outing but she won at her two attempts prior and is worth another chance from the pole position. SANDELTON (7) remains undefeated in two starts but a negative swing in the barrier draw will make it a tougher task this evening. She did defeat ARZALI ROCKSTAR (3) at her latest success so she is not to be underestimated. BACK: TWIGSTAR (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: TWIGSTAR (4), ARZALI ROCKSTAR (3), BRAVE ART (2), OZZIE DIAMOND (1)

OVERVIEW:TASTE IT (3) led throughout at a Shepparton victory on September 01 and finished second from behind the leader at Shepparton last week. She is drawn to obtain a prominent position again and should go well. ALPHA CRUCIS (7) is poorly drawn but will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment. He was held up for a run at a vital stage and used the sprint lane when an unlucky fifth (2m) at Melton two starts ago. LOAN SAILOR (8) was resuming since a win at Stawell when she galloped away and lost her chance at Geelong. She is not without a chance if she delivers a fool proof display. CHALKNCHEDDAR (4) ran a reasonable race from three back on the markers at Swan Hill last week and is worth a ticket each way in an open race. SELECTIONS: TASTE IT (3), ALPHA CRUCIS (7), LOAN SAILOR (8), CHALKNCHEDDAR (4)

OVERVIEW: MY ULTIMATE BARNEY (6) appears to be extremely well graded in this event and is clearly the horse to beat. He followed an eighth behind Bulletproof Boy in the Smoken Up Sprint with a strong effort in a heat of the South Australian Cup on Saturday night. JUSTALITTLESIP (5) was making ground out wide on the track but was severely checked with 150m remaining and lost his chance at Swan Hill last outing. He is also well placed in this event and should improve on his numerical form. IMA TERMINATOR (2) is a versatile pacer, which has the ability to show up under these conditions. He ran a reasonable race when fifth behind Ultimate Vinnie (won again since) in fast time at Ballarat last outing. PAS GUARANTEE (4) was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off well for fourth when resuming. He should be fitter from that run and is capable of filling a place. BACK: MY ULTIMATE BARNEY (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: MY ULTIMATE BARNEY (6), JUSTALITTLESIP (5), IMA TERMINATOR (2), PAS GUARANTEE (4)

OVERVIEW: BEAUTIFUL SUNRISE (5) was resuming since March when she took advantage of a soft trip and finished off best to win at Geelong. She was in good form at the end of her last campaign and commenced her current preparation nicely so she should prove hard to beat again. CHINSKI (1) was attempting to hold the inside advantage but was checked and galloped on the first turn when an unlucky fifth at Geelong. He races best when he is able to lead so he has the conditions to suit him here. MASSIF CENTRAL (2) is also a fast beginner, which should be prominent throughout. He won from behind the leader at Kilmore three starts ago. GATESYS MATE (7) performed below expectations when he was resuming from a spell but this is a drop back in class and his form last preparation was good enough to be competitive under these conditions. SELECTIONS: BEAUTIFUL SUNRISE (5), CHINSKI (1), MASSIF CENTRAL (2), GATESYS MATE (7)

THERESACHANCE (1) doesn’t have the best numerical form in the race but is seemingly going much better than his numerical form suggests. He finished sixth last time out but was closing well late and wasn’t beaten far in a race taken out by The Harris Hawk. He looks suited by the draw and can run well again. ROLLYARRRZ (4) has bounced back to form in recent outings and was able to score a good win leading all the way two starts ago before sitting without cover and battling on well for third last time out. He draws reasonably and can press forward and find a prominent position in this race. MITCHELLS RUN (6) draws outside the front row in this race but does have very good early speed. He was able to lead last time out and was run down late by Maywyn Valentino finishing third. BURNS BAY (7) broke through for another win last time out when running over the top late to score in moderate time. He does step up in grade but should be suited by the draw and could be suited by the step back to the shorter trip. SELECTIONS: THERESACHANCE (1), ROLLYARRRZ (4), MITCHELLS RUN (6), BURNS BAY (7) SUGGESTED BET: THERESACHANCE (1) to win.

MALARKY (2) was able to find the front last time out over the 2040 at this track and was able to win impressively rating good time for the grade and dashed up a nice last quarter. She looks likely to be able to lead again and should be hard to run down. HIGHNMIGHTY (8) found the front last time out and was able to win well there and rate good time. She draws less favourably this time on the back row but appears likely to get the ideal run through early and should settle close enough. TERRAGONG SWINGER (9) appears likely to get a good run off the speed in this race. He got back from a wide draw two starts ago and ran on strongly into third behind The Harris Hawk. DIGBY DEVIL (7) was a good winner last time out after being very well driven early to nab the 1 out 1 back position and run over the top late. He looks likely to need some luck this time but should get a soft run and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: MALARKY (2), HIGHNMIGHTY (8), TERRAGONG SWINGER (9), DIGBY DEVIL (7) SUGGESTED BET: MALARKY (2) to win.

MISS FROUFROU (1) should be able to drive through and lead early in this race. She elected to lead last time out in a very strong mares race taken out by Lilstrepo over Shes Crunchy where she may have been better suited driven with a sit and also sustained a flat tyre which contributed to her beaten margin. She drops back in class and can lead for a long way this time. MISTER SEASIDE (3) ran a good race two starts ago when settling close to the speed and just being run down late by Kick The Switch who had the perfect track into the race on his back. He should secure a good run close to the speed in this race and can be running on late. CALL IT BLING (7) should get a good run through early in this race behind the likely leader. He was forced to do plenty of work last time out in a race taken out by King Bling at Albion Park and should be better suited in this race. STORMTIDE (8) was able to lead before handing over last time out at this track and was able to sprint best to score. He should secure a good run behind the speed in this race and can look to be running on late. SELECTIONS: MISS FROUFROU (1), MISTER SEASIDE (3), CALL IT BLING (7), STORMTIDE (8) SUGGESTED BET: MISS FROUFROU (1) to win.

JIMMY BLING (1) has drawn favourably in this race and looks likely to be able to drive through and lead in the early stages. He was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on well there for third behind Rocky Leigh. MISTER DELWIN (7) should get a good run through behind the likely leader in the early stages of this race from a soft trailing draw. He hasn’t had much luck in recent outings including last time out when shuffled back on the pegs. He should get every chance. HOLME BOY (2) looks set to secure a good run close enough to the speed in this race from a good draw. He got shuffled back and was running on late into fourth behind Burns Bay. ASHLEE NITRO (10) hasn’t quite been at her absolute best in recent outings but seemingly finds the right type of race and does love to race at this track and trip. She should be running on well late. SELECTIONS: JIMMY BLING (1), MISTER DELWIN (7), HOLME BOY (2), ASHLEE NITRO (10) SUGGESTED BET: JIMMY BLING (1) to win.

SHEEZ GOT TORQUE (2) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race from an ideal draw. She finds herself back in grade off some of her better efforts and should be hard enough to run down. ART OF ROCK (5) was held up at a crucial stage last time out before finishing it off nicely into a distant second behind Britts Mate. He draws a touch awkwardly towards the outside of the front row but is suited being sat up and saved for one run. PERFECT LOU (9) should get a good run off the speed in this race and has been racing well. He does seem to do his best work out in front but with the race run to suit he could be running into it late. LYDIAS ART (8) returns from a spell in this race off the back of moderate trials. She should be suited by the draw and can be running into it late. SELECTIONS: SHEEZ GOT TORQUE (2), ART OF ROCK (5), PERFECT LOU (9), LYDIAS ART (8) SUGGESTED BET: SHEEZ GOT TORQUE (2) to win.

WANDARY DELIGHT (2) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race. She sat close to the speed last time out and was running on well late into second behind Jilliby Panda after securing the right run. DIGBY JOY (3) was able to show gate speed and lead last time out when putting in a poor run fading out of it late into fifth. She may just be better suited sat up and saved for one run and can look to bounce back in this race. ILLBEWATCHING (7) should get a good run through early in this race and will just be relying on luck at the right time to get into the clear. He ran on late last time out into third on the grass at Kilcoy in a race taken out by My Ultimate Louie. PERFECT FEELING (5) was able to lead last time out when run down late by Rosarito who had the good run in that race on his back. He can look for a prominent position and can run well again. SELECTIONS: WANDARY DELIGHT (2), DIGBY JOY (3), ILLBEWATCHING (7), PERFECT FEELING (5) SUGGESTED BET: WANDARY DELIGHT (2) to win.

JUSTANOTHER TORQUE (5) was aggressively driven last time out to hold the lead over the 2138 at Albion Park and put in an excellent effort there finishing a close up third to subsequent winner Blackjack. She is likely to be aggressively driven again in this race and if she could find the front she would likely take plenty of running down. AESTHETE (9) was able to run a good second last time out when working into the clear early before being run down late by his stablemate What Is His Name. He looks likely to get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. AUNTY MEL (4) draws well in this race and should able to work forward and find a prominent position. She was able to lead three starts ago and battled on for a distant second behind Wicked Berries. WICKED WHISKEY (7) led last time out and battled on well there for third behind What Is His Name who had a soft run off the speed. He should get a good run through in this race and will just be relying on luck at the right time. SELECTIONS: JUSTANOTHER TORQUE (5), AESTHETE (9), AUNTY MEL (4), WICKED WHISKEY (7) SUGGESTED BET: JUSTANOTHER TORQUE (5) to win.

UNCLE NOLAN (9) was able to secure the right run last time out when sprinting nicely late to get into second in a race taken out by Doublefault. He comes into this race third up and should be nearing peak fitness. He looks hard to beat. BROADWAYBEAUTY (3) appears to have reasonable gate speed and may be able to press to the lead which could see her an improver in this race. She secured a good run last time out at Albion Park and wasn’t beaten too far there behind Cherry Surprise. JOVIAL JIM (5) hasn’t quite been at his absolute best in two runs so far on return from a spell. He secured a great run first up and was run down by What Is His Name before sitting without cover last time out and fading out of it late. His best is good enough. DISEMBARK (6) draws poorly in this race outside the front row. He ran on nicely last time out into third in a similar race to this one. SELECTIONS: UNCLE NOLAN (9), BROADWAYBEAUTY (3), JOVIAL JIM (5), DISEMBARK (6) SUGGESTED BET: UNCLE NOLAN (9) to win.

FREE REIGN (4) raced in much stronger company last time out when not having a lot of luck including last start when sitting without cover and running third to Adah Koko. He was very good in a recent trial behind Magic Miki not being beaten too far in fifth. He looks the winner. MERITS RESPECT (5) ran well in recent trial taken out by his higher assessed stablemate Betterthanpopsy. He is out of the same mare as Merry Jewel who has had plenty of Redcliffe success. He draws awkwardly but finds a race without a lot of depth and should be thereabouts with the right run. AURELIE (6) has been prone to doing things wrong in her races. She was very well driven last time out to nab the position behind the leader and just couldn’t quite finish the race off there. She should be running on late. PAMPERED ART (2) has good gate speed and should be able to press forward and find a prominent position. She comes into this race fourth up from a spell and looks to have top four claims. SELECTIONS: FREE REIGN (4), MERITS RESPECT (5), AURELIE (6), PAMPERED ART (2) SUGGESTED BET: FREE REIGN (4) to win.
